title: CI gate steps stay robust and fast under failures and reopen
acceptance: Reopening a PR with an unchanged head does not leave a green required check while owner-approved has just been removed.
A failing self-test or Install step yields a clear gate message instead of 'Cannot find module' from the final gate steps.
Playwright's browser download is cached across runs; the symlink-safe CLI guard has one tested implementation where the CI copy constraint allows.
nextAction: Pick the cheapest fixes first (reopen handling, clear message when gate inputs are missing), then caching.

evidence.summary: Final review #5 of #643: non-significant CI findings (reopen flip, early steps without !cancelled(), Playwright cache, duplicated guard). Logged 2026-10-27 under the significance rule.
